item.title: Steel: Scaling Simulation Across Robots, Tasks, and Worlds
item.description: Together with NVIDIA, we're introducing Steel, a GPU-accelerated rigid-body dynamics solver for the open-source Newton physics engine, delivering 3.8× PhysX's simulation throughput across 20 robot-learning benchmarks and up to 13.0× on heterogeneous batches of different robots and tasks.
